preconditions.description: The length of the input text is no more than 10000 characters.
The input text consists of lowercase Latin letters, spaces, and punctuation marks (dot, comma, exclamation mark, question mark).
The text begins and ends with a Latin letter.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() or c.isspace() or c in '.,!?' for c in text)
preconditions.description: There is at least one word between any two punctuation marks.

postconditions.description: The output text has no extra spaces at the end and ends with a space or punctuation mark.
There are no consecutive spaces in the output text.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == ' ' and output[i+1] not in '.,!?' for i in range(len(output)-1) if output[i] == ' ' and output[i+1] != ' ')
postconditions.description: There is exactly one space after each punctuation mark.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] != ' ' and output[i+1] == ' ' for i in range(len(output)-1) if output[i] != ' ' and output[i+1] == ' ')
postconditions.description: There are no spaces before each punctuation mark.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i].isalpha() and output[i+1].isalpha() for i in range(len(output)-1) if output[i].isalpha() and output[i+1].isalpha())
postconditions.description: Words are separated by exactly one space if there is no punctuation mark between them.
